reason: Reviewer documents, consent records, raw provider replies, and private source provenance never enter teacher DTOs. Keys are forbidden before submission. After frozen submission, only the separately gated key-disclosure projection may expose the reviewed linguistic key under GAP-002’s proposed policy.
Remove two verbatim repeated operation-state sections.

Use RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), encoded as UTF-8, for structured hash projections. Reject duplicate keys, unpaired surrogates, non-finite numbers and integers outside the interoperable safe-integer range unless the schema represents them as decimal strings. Generic key sorting is not an equivalent encoder. No Unicode normalization is applied by JCS.

The database key is `(workspace_id, operation_name, idempotency_key)`, where operation_name is the stable domain/operations.yaml operation ID, not the per-request UUID. Hash a JCS object containing the operation name, normalized concrete path (including target), query parameters, If-Match revision or null, and parsed body (or exact binary-body SHA-256). A changed target, body, query or revision under the same key returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. The original receipt remains immutable.

Assign `clm_` plus the first 32 hexadecimal SHA-256 digits of UTF-8 JCS encoding of the ordered array [answer_sha256, start_cp, end_cp, exact_text]. Offset values are safe integers. Do not concatenate undelimited strings. Hash collisions or competing interpretations of an identical span require review and cannot overwrite the original clause.

Append each turn’s samples in order and insert exactly gap_after_ms*24 zero samples after it; gap_after_ms is the render-plan integer field. Apply it to every turn, including the final turn, when nonzero. No unspecified gap_ms field exists. These planned intervals are retained on the final sample clock.
